name: @tpmjs/tools-youtube
description: Upload and manage videos on your own YouTube channel: resumable uploads from a URL (continued across calls), status, updates, thumbnails, playlists — headless OAuth with a refresh token

env.name: YOUTUBE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Google OAuth client id (a "Desktop app" client with the YouTube Data API v3 enabled)

env.name: YOUTUBE_REFRESH_TOKEN
env.description: Refresh token for the channel owner, minted once with youtubeAuthUrl → youtubeExchangeCode

env.name: YOUTUBE_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: Optional short-lived access token used instead of the refresh-token flow

tools.name: youtubeAuthUrl
tools.description: One-time setup step 1: build the Google consent URL that authorises this OAuth client to manage your channel.

tools.name: youtubeExchangeCode
tools.description: One-time setup step 2: exchange the consent code for the long-lived refresh token to store as YOUTUBE_REFRESH_TOKEN.

tools.name: myChannel
tools.description: Show the channel these credentials control: id, title, handle, subscriber/video/view counts, uploads playlist.

tools.name: uploadVideo
tools.description: Upload a video from a URL in resumable chunks; long files continue across calls via the returned sessionUri. Optional playlist and thumbnail.

tools.name: videoStatus
tools.description: Upload/processing status, privacy, schedule, failure reasons and stats for one of your videos.

tools.name: myVideos
tools.description: List your most recent uploads with privacy, processing state and view/like/comment counts.

tools.name: updateVideo
tools.description: Change title, description, tags, category, privacy, schedule or made-for-kids on a video; untouched fields are preserved.

tools.name: setThumbnail
tools.description: Set a custom thumbnail on a video from an image URL (≤ 2 MB).

tools.name: myPlaylists
tools.description: List your playlists with ids, privacy and item counts.

tools.name: addToPlaylist
tools.description: Add a video to one of your playlists.

tools.name: deleteVideo
tools.description: Permanently delete one of your videos (irreversible).

tools.name: videoCategories
tools.description: List the assignable YouTube category ids for a region.
